entries.title: BELFAST/COUNTY MILK NI FERRY LANE — I.15 VESSEL TICK
entries.description: On the County Milk → Leprino Foods lane (Belfast XIBEL1-DAERA, unaccompanied ferry), I.15 should show Vessel + Road vehicle both ticked. Vessel not ticked despite an unaccompanied/vessel-named identification (e.g. "UNACCOMPANIED / STENA CONNECTA") — medium warning (AMBER), OV to confirm transport mode boxes correctly reflect the ro-ro crossing before dispatch. Vessel name in Identification alongside "UNACCOMPANIED" is correct and expected — do not flag the vessel reference itself. This partially resolves the open B1 I.15 PENDING note for this specific lane; the wider NI/DAERA I.15 and I.13 exit-port question remains open pending further confirmation. This note applies ONLY to the County Milk → Leprino Foods Belfast XIBEL1-DAERA lane. All other NI/DAERA-destined loads remain under the B1 I.15 PENDING note (no flag on I.15 tick pattern) until the wider pattern is confirmed.
